zh.question: 朋友想调整休闲安排。他常常看短视频超时，也想了解附近的线下活动。四类信息都能收集，你最想先从哪项开始？
options: 记录自动连播开关与每次使用时长。
记录每次使用时长，查看它们如何分布。
记录使用前的疲惫程度和近期休息情况。
记录附近休闲设施的开放时间和使用情况。

en.question: A friend wants to rethink their leisure time. They often watch short videos longer than planned and also want to explore nearby offline activities. All four kinds of information can be collected. Which would you most like to investigate first?
options: Record autoplay settings and session lengths.
Record session lengths and examine their distribution.
Record tiredness before use and recent rest.
Record opening hours and use of nearby leisure facilities.

lens-v2-001-opt-06.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：记录自动连播开关与每次使用时长。
lens-v2-001-opt-06.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to record autoplay settings and session lengths.

lens-v2-001-opt-05.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：记录每次使用时长，查看它们如何分布。
lens-v2-001-opt-05.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to record session lengths and examine their distribution.

lens-v2-001-opt-09.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：记录使用前的疲惫程度和近期休息情况。
lens-v2-001-opt-09.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to record tiredness before use and recent rest.

lens-v2-001-opt-10.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：记录附近休闲设施的开放时间和使用情况。
lens-v2-001-opt-10.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to record opening hours and use of nearby leisure facilities.

zh.question: 社区花园的几个种植区长势不同。你想多了解这件事，四类资料都能查到。你最想先看哪类？
options: 比较各区的土壤、植物种类和养护记录。
查看灌溉管路的布置与出水位置。
查看种苗采购和日常维护的预算分配。
了解居民怎样参与、分工和约定共享规则。

en.question: Several areas of a community garden are growing differently. All four kinds of information are available. Which would you most like to examine first?
options: Compare soil, plant species and care records across areas.
Examine irrigation pipe layouts and outlet positions.
Examine budgets for seedlings and routine maintenance.
Ask how residents participate, share work and agree on rules.

lens-v2-002-opt-08.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：比较各区的土壤、植物种类和养护记录。
lens-v2-002-opt-08.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to compare soil, plant species and care records across areas.

lens-v2-002-opt-07.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：查看灌溉管路的布置与出水位置。
lens-v2-002-opt-07.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to examine irrigation pipe layouts and outlet positions.

lens-v2-002-opt-04.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：查看种苗采购和日常维护的预算分配。
lens-v2-002-opt-04.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to examine budgets for seedlings and routine maintenance.

lens-v2-002-opt-03.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：了解居民怎样参与、分工和约定共享规则。
lens-v2-002-opt-03.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to ask how residents participate, share work and agree on rules.

zh.question: 图书馆准备改进一个小型互动展览。你可以先研究其中一方面，四项资料都可获得。你最想了解哪项？
options: 查看展品、图像与故事怎样共同表达主题。
观察讲解后，访客能否独立完成互动练习。
请访客读一段指引，再说出下一步怎么做。
观察访客如何进入、等候和寻求现场帮助。

en.question: A library is improving a small interactive exhibition. Information is available for each of these areas. Which would you most like to investigate first?
options: Examine how objects, images and stories express the theme.
Observe whether visitors can complete an activity unaided after instruction.
Ask visitors to read instructions and describe the next step.
Observe how visitors enter, wait and request on-site help.

lens-v2-003-opt-02.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：查看展品、图像与故事怎样共同表达主题。
lens-v2-003-opt-02.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to examine how objects, images and stories express the theme.

lens-v2-003-opt-01.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：观察讲解后，访客能否独立完成互动练习。
lens-v2-003-opt-01.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to observe whether visitors can complete an activity unaided after instruction.

lens-v2-003-opt-00.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：请访客读一段指引，再说出下一步怎么做。
lens-v2-003-opt-00.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to ask visitors to read instructions and describe the next step.

lens-v2-003-opt-10.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：观察访客如何进入、等候和寻求现场帮助。
lens-v2-003-opt-10.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to observe how visitors enter, wait and request on-site help.

zh.question: 几位朋友使用同一间工作室，想让它更适合大家使用。你可以先收集一种信息。你最想看哪项？
options: 测量桌面、灯具和通道的空间位置。
了解大家工作时的身体不适和休息情况。
查看共享设备、文件权限与网络连接设置。
查看场地成本与使用时段如何分摊。

en.question: Friends share a workspace and want it to work better for everyone. Which kind of information would you most like to collect first?
options: Measure the positions of desks, lights and walkways.
Ask about physical discomfort during work and rest breaks.
Examine shared devices, file permissions and network settings.
Examine how space costs and usage periods are shared.

lens-v2-004-opt-07.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：测量桌面、灯具和通道的空间位置。
lens-v2-004-opt-07.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to measure the positions of desks, lights and walkways.

lens-v2-004-opt-09.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：了解大家工作时的身体不适和休息情况。
lens-v2-004-opt-09.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to ask about physical discomfort during work and rest breaks.

lens-v2-004-opt-06.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：查看共享设备、文件权限与网络连接设置。
lens-v2-004-opt-06.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to examine shared devices, file permissions and network settings.

lens-v2-004-opt-04.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：查看场地成本与使用时段如何分摊。
lens-v2-004-opt-04.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to examine how space costs and usage periods are shared.

zh.question: 街区市场准备调整一个食品摊位的展示。四个调查方向都已列入计划，你最想先了解哪项？
options: 查看定价、成本与每笔销售的收益。
了解食材怎样种植、收获和保存。
研究颜色、图案和故事如何表达产地特色。
比较不同时段的客流数量与变化范围。

en.question: A neighbourhood market is updating a food stall display. All four investigations are planned. Which would you most like to explore first?
options: Examine pricing, costs and returns from each sale.
Find out how ingredients are grown, harvested and stored.
Study how colours, patterns and stories express local identity.
Compare visitor counts and their variation across time periods.

lens-v2-005-opt-04.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：查看定价、成本与每笔销售的收益。
lens-v2-005-opt-04.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to examine pricing, costs and returns from each sale.

lens-v2-005-opt-08.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：了解食材怎样种植、收获和保存。
lens-v2-005-opt-08.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to find out how ingredients are grown, harvested and stored.

lens-v2-005-opt-02.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：研究颜色、图案和故事如何表达产地特色。
lens-v2-005-opt-02.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to study how colours, patterns and stories express local identity.

lens-v2-005-opt-05.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：比较不同时段的客流数量与变化范围。
lens-v2-005-opt-05.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to compare visitor counts and their variation across time periods.

zh.question: 公园准备改进一条步道。四类资料都能帮助讨论方案，你最想先研究哪类？
options: 查看沿线植物、土壤与雨后积水的记录。
了解不同居民群体怎样使用这条步道。
查看坡度、路面材料和排水结构。
观察路标、休息点与访客问路的情况。

en.question: A park is improving a path. Each kind of information can inform the discussion. Which would you most like to examine first?
options: Examine records of plants, soil and standing water after rain.
Ask how different resident groups use the path.
Examine slopes, surface materials and drainage structures.
Observe signs, rest stops and visitors asking for directions.

lens-v2-006-opt-08.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：查看沿线植物、土壤与雨后积水的记录。
lens-v2-006-opt-08.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to examine records of plants, soil and standing water after rain.

lens-v2-006-opt-03.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：了解不同居民群体怎样使用这条步道。
lens-v2-006-opt-03.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to ask how different resident groups use the path.

lens-v2-006-opt-07.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：查看坡度、路面材料和排水结构。
lens-v2-006-opt-07.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to examine slopes, surface materials and drainage structures.

lens-v2-006-opt-10.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：观察路标、休息点与访客问路的情况。
lens-v2-006-opt-10.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to observe signs, rest stops and visitors asking for directions.

zh.question: 一个线上短课想改进学习体验。你可以先了解其中一个方面，四项都不要求你已有专业经验。你最想研究哪项？
options: 观察学习者练习时需要哪些提示和反馈。
查看播放、检索和保存进度的功能设计。
比较练习得分的分布与前后变化。
研究措辞、比喻和画面怎样传达内容。

en.question: A short online course is improving its learning experience. You can investigate any area without prior specialist experience. Which would you prefer to explore first?
options: Observe what prompts and feedback learners need during practice.
Examine playback, search and progress-saving functions.
Compare the distribution of practice scores and changes over time.
Study how wording, metaphors and images convey the content.

lens-v2-007-opt-01.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：观察学习者练习时需要哪些提示和反馈。
lens-v2-007-opt-01.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to observe what prompts and feedback learners need during practice.

lens-v2-007-opt-06.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：查看播放、检索和保存进度的功能设计。
lens-v2-007-opt-06.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to examine playback, search and progress-saving functions.

lens-v2-007-opt-05.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：比较练习得分的分布与前后变化。
lens-v2-007-opt-05.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to compare the distribution of practice scores and changes over time.

lens-v2-007-opt-02.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：研究措辞、比喻和画面怎样传达内容。
lens-v2-007-opt-02.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to study how wording, metaphors and images convey the content.

zh.question: 社区组织免费步行导览，想让报名和参与更顺畅。四类信息都能收集。你最想先了解哪类？
options: 查看报名者怎样理解表格里的词语和要求。
观察示范一次报名后，新参与者如何再尝试。
了解不同居民的可参与时段和出行条件。
了解路线体力要求与参加者自述的身体限制。

en.question: A community is organising a free guided walk and wants registration and participation to go smoothly. Which information would you most like to collect first?
options: Examine how applicants understand form wording and requirements.
Observe how new participants retry registration after a demonstration.
Ask about residents’ available times and travel circumstances.
Examine physical demands and participants’ reported limitations.

lens-v2-008-opt-00.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：查看报名者怎样理解表格里的词语和要求。
lens-v2-008-opt-00.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to examine how applicants understand form wording and requirements.

lens-v2-008-opt-01.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：观察示范一次报名后，新参与者如何再尝试。

lens-v2-008-opt-03.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：了解不同居民的可参与时段和出行条件。
lens-v2-008-opt-03.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to ask about residents’ available times and travel circumstances.

lens-v2-008-opt-09.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：了解路线体力要求与参加者自述的身体限制。
lens-v2-008-opt-09.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to examine physical demands and participants’ reported limitations.

zh.question: 朋友们一起准备小型社区展览。假设每项任务都有资料或协助，你都能完成，预计用时相近，也没有必须先做哪项的要求。你更愿意负责哪项？
options: 选择图像与声音，让展览主题有清楚的表达。
把参观指引改写成容易读懂的日常语言。
设计一段练习，帮助访客理解一个展览概念。
设计接待和问路方式，让参观过程顺畅。

en.question: Friends are preparing a small community exhibition. Assume you have information or help for each task, can complete any of them, and they take similar time. None has to come first. Which would you prefer to take on?
options: Choose images and sounds that clearly express the theme.
Rewrite visitor instructions in clear everyday language.
Design an activity to help visitors learn one exhibition concept.
Design reception and wayfinding for a smooth visit.

task-v2-001-opt-02.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：选择图像与声音，让展览主题有清楚的表达。
task-v2-001-opt-02.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to choose images and sounds that clearly express the theme.

task-v2-001-opt-00.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：把参观指引改写成容易读懂的日常语言。
task-v2-001-opt-00.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to rewrite visitor instructions in clear everyday language.

task-v2-001-opt-01.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：设计一段练习，帮助访客理解一个展览概念。
task-v2-001-opt-01.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to design an activity to help visitors learn one exhibition concept.

task-v2-001-opt-10.reflectionZh: 这次你选择了：设计接待和问路方式，让参观过程顺畅。
task-v2-001-opt-10.reflectionEn: This time, you chose to design reception and wayfinding for a smooth visit.

options: 根据种植资料选择植物和养护安排。
根据图纸检查花箱尺寸和灌溉连接。
比较采购方案，整理费用和维护预算。
整理居民意见，拟定共同使用的约定。

Use drawings to check planter dimensions and irrigation connections.
Compare purchases and prepare a maintenance budget.

zh.question: 图书馆试办一个工具借用柜。假设每项任务都有资料或协助，你都能完成，预计用时相近，也没有必须先做哪项的要求。你更愿意负责哪项？
options: 配置借还记录表单和不同使用者的访问权限。
分析借用数量，画出需求随时间变化的图。
把借还说明整理成清楚的步骤和检查清单。
设计取还交接和排队等候的服务流程。

en.question: A library is piloting a tool-lending cabinet. Assume you have information or help for each task, can complete any of them, and they take similar time. None has to come first. Which would you prefer to take on?
options: Configure loan forms and access permissions for different users.
Analyse loan counts and chart how demand changes over time.
Turn lending instructions into clear steps and a checklist.
Design handovers and queueing for collection and return.

options: 设计示范和练习，帮助新手逐步独立制作。

options: Design demonstrations and practice so beginners can work independently.

Use measurements to check that bases and parts fit.

zh.question: 社区准备一次短距离步行导览。假设每项任务都有资料或协助，你都能完成，预计用时相近，也没有必须先做哪项的要求。你更愿意负责哪项？
options: 整理集合、路线指引和散场的服务安排。
核对饮水与身体不适提醒的资料。

options: Plan meeting points, route guidance and departure arrangements.
Check sources for hydration and physical-discomfort guidance.
